description.zh: 声码持续时长，单位为秒，取值范围为1～30。
description.en: The duration of the sound code, in seconds. Valid values: 1 to 30.

description.zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。</ph></props>

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>
description.en:
The instance ID.<props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of your current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the invocation fails.
- If no ID exists, you do not need to specify it.

></notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

description.zh: 声码名称，长度为1~64个字符，一个汉字占两个字符，实例下保证唯一。
description.en: The name of the sound code. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as two characters. The name must be unique within the instance.
The unique identifier of the sound code.

description.zh: 声码营销内容，例如商品的详情地址等，长度限制100个字符。
description.en: The marketing content of the sound code, such as the product detail URL. The content can be up to 100 characters in length.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为2。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Queries per second (QPS) limit
Each Alibaba Cloud account can send a maximum of 2 requests per second (QPS) to invoke this API.
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot update-sound-code --duration 2 --sound-code-content www.taobao.com --sound-code Md3ZiTL888K9llXDy789000000000000 --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --name test --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot UpdateSoundCode --region cn-hangzhou --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --Duration 2 --SoundCodeContent 'www.taobao.com' --SoundCode Md3ZiTL888K9llXDy789000000000000 --Name test
